baseline_models.mechanism: The passive return routes inquiry about the Hour to one epistemic terminus; the repeated knowledge-root then extends that sole jurisdiction into hidden natural processes.

activation_trace.role: Return to a source supplies the directional referral of Hour-knowledge to its sole terminus.
Disclosure to a knower joins knowledge of the Hour to knowledge of otherwise concealed processes.

changed_reading.before: The time of the Hour is unknown except to God.
changed_reading.after: Every inquiry about the Hour is referred back to God as the sole epistemic terminus, whose knowing also reaches each hidden transition named next.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: تَخْرُجُ مِن ثَمَرَاتٍ مِنْ أَكْمَامِهَا وَمَا تَحْمِلُ مِنْ أُنثَى وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلْمِهِ
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah pairs two enclosure-to-manifestation sequences: fruit crosses its sheath, and an internal pregnancy reaches delivery. Divine knowledge spans both incubation and the exact boundary crossing.

activation_trace.role: The plant vessel and fruit-cover supply the protected hidden state from which emergence begins.
Passage to the outside supplies the first threshold from concealment to manifestation.
Internal pregnancy and tree-bearing join botanical and animal generation as homologous hidden loads.
Delivery supplies the second threshold at which an inwardly carried life becomes externally present.
Knowledge as a distinguishing mark makes every concealed process and transition individually determinate.

changed_reading.after: Divine knowing continuously spans hidden incubation, individual differentiation, and the exact threshold at which each content crosses into manifestation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَيَوْمَ يُنَادِيهِمْ أَيْنَ شُرَكَائِي قَالُوا آذَنَّاكَ مَا مِنَّا مِن شَهِيدٍ
baseline_models.mechanism: A public summons converts partnership from an asserted association into an evidentiary question. Their notified declaration cannot supply either a present co-partner or knowledge-bearing testimony.

activation_trace.role: The raised public call supplies the hearing-like summons that brings the claimants to answer.
Joint participation supplies the alleged shared standing that the question puts to proof.
Notification grounded in knowledge makes their response a formal disclosure rather than an unheard aside.
Knowledge-bearing testimony supplies the missing evidentiary support whose absence collapses the partnership claim.

changed_reading.before: They deny having a witness for the alleged partners.
changed_reading.after: The final exchange is an evidentiary hearing in which the alleged joint standing produces neither an appearing co-partner nor testimony capable of sustaining the claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first stages knowledge as delivered downward, differentiated into intelligible parts, and received by people who know; the focus then routes the terminal timing question back to its source.

activation_trace.role: Delivered descent supplies the outgoing motion of disclosure from God toward its hearers.
Detailing that exposes parts and meanings makes the descended disclosure humanly differentiable.
Knowledge as disclosure to a knower supplies the human reception enabled by that detailing.
Return to source reverses the motion for the specific question of the Hour.
The repeated knowledge-root anchors both the limit on timing and the disclosure of hidden processes.

structural_cues: 41:2-3 opens with a revelation sent down, detailed signs, and a people who know.
41:47 changes the direction with knowledge of the Hour being returned to Him.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies descending disclosure, detailed human knowing, and returned Hour-knowledge; I infer a bounded two-direction epistemic economy in which signs come outward while terminal timing goes back to source. Alternatively, 'returned' may denote referral in dispute without any spatial circulation.

changed_reading.before: Knowledge of the Hour is simply withheld from humans.
changed_reading.after: The surah permits substantial disclosed knowledge while marking one jurisdictional boundary: intelligible signs are delivered outward, but the terminal timing question is routed back to its source.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured cosmic creation, apportioned sustenance, and visibly revived earth turn the focus's fruit and pregnancy sequence into a small-scale enactment of ordered creation and life emerging from a hidden or quiescent state.

activation_trace.role: Creative bringing-into-being supplies the macrocosmic frame for the focus's generated lives.
Deliberate apportionment supplies ordered timing and measure rather than undifferentiated natural occurrence.
Life-sustaining provision supplies the material maintenance within the measured creative order.
A visible sign makes the earth's change an evidentiary analogue rather than mere scenery.
Earth made alive through rain and vegetation links botanical emergence to the stated capacity to restore life.
Loss of life supplies the terminal state explicitly reversed by the same life-giving agency.
Fruit crossing outward becomes a local instance of life moving into visible form.
Internal gestation supplies the concealed phase of generated life.
Birth supplies the completed emergence that makes the measured life-cycle observable.

structural_cues: 41:9-12 presents creation in stages, provisions apportioned, and the whole order named a determination of the Knowing One.
41:39 moves from rain, stirring, and swelling earth directly to giving life to the dead.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured macro-creation, apportioned sustenance, earth's vegetative revival, and the focus's fruit and birth thresholds; I infer that the biological sequence is a microcosmic sign of the same creation-revival mechanism. Alternatively, the examples may only inventory omniscience without intentionally modeling resurrection.

changed_reading.before: Fruit emergence and pregnancy are unrelated examples proving exhaustive knowledge.
changed_reading.after: They are miniature, measured creation-revival sequences that make hidden generation itself evidence toward the Hour whose timing remains God's knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier in the surah, assembled defendants face testimony from their own faculties, which God enables to speak; their error was assuming much of their conduct escaped His knowledge. This makes the focus's lack of a witness for partners an asymmetry of evidence, not an empty record.

activation_trace.role: Driving and gathering a group to one destination supplies the public assembly for testimony.
Knowledge-bearing testimony by hearing, sight, and skins supplies abundant evidence against the speakers.
Enabled speech explains how created faculties become articulate witnesses rather than mute objects.
Mistaken supposition supplies the defendants' failed belief that much of their conduct was unobserved.
Knowledge as disclosed awareness directly negates the imagined gap in divine observation.
The alleged joint participation is the proposition for which supporting testimony fails.
The same knowledge-bearing testimony category is explicitly absent on the partner side.

structural_cues: 41:19-22 gathers defendants, makes hearing, sight, and skins testify, and attributes their speech to God.
41:22 identifies their operative mistake as thinking God did not know much of what they did.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies abundant created testimony, divinely enabled speech, and a mistaken belief in unobserved conduct; I infer that 'none of us is a witness' marks evidentiary asymmetry, not lack of evidence altogether. Alternatively, the focus's witness may mean a present adherent rather than a forensic witness, though that still leaves the partnership unsupported.

changed_reading.before: The alleged partners are absent and no one testifies for them.
changed_reading.after: The partner claim fails inside an evidence-rich judgment: created faculties can testify against the claimants, while no knowledge-bearing testimony exists on behalf of divine co-participation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah reverses the direction of calling: those who formerly invoked others are now called by God, and what they invoked is lost from them while every route of evasion closes.

activation_trace.role: The branch's loss of an object makes the alleged partners not merely silent but unfindable to their former callers.
Calling by speech supplies the former human-to-partner invocation whose direction the focus reverses.
Turning aside from a direction supplies the escape route now recognized as unavailable.
God's raised call places the former callers in the answering position.
The claimed joint participants are the missing objects exposed by the reversed summons.

structural_cues: 41:47 has God call the claimants and ask where His alleged partners are.
41:48 immediately says what they used to call has been lost from them and that they have no escape.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies God's summons followed by the disappearance of what they formerly invoked; I infer a deliberate reversal from caller to called and from expected responder to lost object. Alternatively, 41:48 may simply narrate the sequel without making the directional reversal a designed mechanism.

changed_reading.before: God asks a question and the alleged partners fail to appear.
changed_reading.after: Judgment inverts the entire invocation relation: former callers become respondents, while the beings they treated as callable partners become irretrievably absent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus speaker denies the Hour by conjecture yet conditionally imagines a favorable return to the Lord. The focus's referral of Hour-knowledge blocks this selective private forecast and relocates both timing and outcome beyond self-entitling speculation.

activation_trace.role: Doubtful supposition supplies the unsupported denial of the Hour.
Rising, resurrection, and the standing Hour supply the event that conjecture declares unlikely.
Referral back to source removes the Hour from private epistemic ownership.
Knowledge as actual disclosure contrasts with a desired outcome projected from conjecture.

structural_cues: 41:50 says the beneficiary does not think the Hour will stand.
The same speaker conditionally imagines being returned to the Lord and receiving the best outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies conjectural denial beside a self-favoring hypothetical return; I infer that the focus's referral of knowledge disqualifies this selective forecast about both timing and entitlement. Alternatively, 41:50 may target ingratitude and arrogance more than an epistemic counterfeit.

changed_reading.before: Only the date of the Hour lies outside human knowledge.
changed_reading.after: The boundary also exposes self-serving pseudo-knowledge: one cannot deny the Hour by conjecture and then privately script a favorable outcome if returned.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah closes by promising signs across outer horizons and inner selves, naming God witness over everything, identifying doubt about meeting Him, and asserting complete cognitive encompassment. The focus condenses that closure into outer fruit, inner gestation, Hour, and failed human witness.

activation_trace.role: Manifest signs supply the evidentiary status of the natural and personal processes named in the focus.
Distant horizons supply the outer domain corresponding to the focus's botanical world.
The self as the thing itself supplies the inner domain corresponding to gestation within living bodies.
God's knowledge-bearing witness over everything answers the human absence of testimony for partners.
Doubt and hesitation identify the human epistemic condition surrounding the coming meeting.
The convergence of two parties supplies the eventual meeting toward which the Hour points.
Complete cognitive encompassment supplies the closing form of the focus's repeated divine knowledge.
Fruit enclosed in its vessel anchors an outer sign whose hidden phase is still encompassed.
Internal gestation anchors a sign within living selves.
Repeated knowledge links Hour, outer emergence, and inner gestation under one awareness.

structural_cues: 41:53 coordinates signs in the horizons and in selves, then names God witness over every thing.
41:54 links doubt about meeting the Lord with His encompassing every thing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outer and inner signs, universal divine witness, doubt about encounter, and total encompassment; I infer that the focus is a compact enactment of that closing grid. Alternatively, the closing formulas may broaden the surah generally rather than intentionally gloss each domain in 41:47.

changed_reading.before: The ayah lists divine knowledge of eschatology and biology, then reports failed testimony.
changed_reading.after: The ayah functions as a hinge of the surah's ending: horizon-signs and self-signs are encompassed by the same knowledge that governs encounter, while divine witness answers the collapse of human witness for partners.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it compares hostile cognitive covers with a protective botanical sheath. It remains anchored in the focus's sheath and knowledge language, while 41:5 supplies explicit covers and a barrier. Render it only as a contrastive echo, not as lexical identity or as a claim that natural sheaths are blameworthy.

activation_trace.role: A preserving cover supplies the self-declared enclosure around hearts that blocks reception.
A screening barrier intensifies the human claim of inaccessible separation.
The fruit's natural vessel supplies a non-culpable enclosure fully traversed by divine knowledge.
Knowledge as disclosure makes concealment compatible with complete divine access.

changed_reading.before: A sheath merely hides and protects fruit.
changed_reading.after: The natural sheath becomes a foil to chosen cognitive enclosure: protected hiddenness remains fully open to divine knowledge, whereas self-claimed covers obstruct human reception.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links biological delivery and judicial testimony through a shared outward-disclosure pattern. It remains anchored in the focus's emergence, birth, summons, and witness sequence, and 41:20-21 supplies bodily testimony made articulate. Render it as a structural analogy only, never as a semantic equation between birth and judgment.

activation_trace.role: Extraction from hiddenness supplies the first movement of latent content becoming manifest.
Delivery supplies a second movement in which inward content becomes externally present.
Knowledge-bearing testimony supplies the juridical form in which hidden allegiance would become declarable evidence.
Bodily testimony demonstrates that latent conduct can be externalized as evidence.
God-enabled speech supplies the mechanism by which a normally mute body releases its testimony.

changed_reading.before: Natural births and the final interrogation are separate examples.
changed_reading.after: The ayah can be heard as a sequence of disclosures: fruit exits, pregnancy delivers, summons draws out a declared allegiance, and testimony fixes what has become manifest.

strongest_changes: The fruit and pregnancy sequence became a microcosm of measured creation and earthly revival, tying hidden generation to the Hour.
The final dialogue became an evidence-rich hearing sharpened by created faculties testifying and by God being witness over everything.
41:48 inverted the call: former invokers are summoned while what they invoked is lost and no route of escape remains.
The closing horizons, selves, meeting, and encompassment cues turned 41:47 into a compact hinge for the surah's conclusion.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah binds epistemic jurisdiction, concealed biological thresholds, and failed partnership testimony. Whole-surah cues reveal a shared movement from concealment to manifestation and from unsupported claim to unavoidable evidence without forcing those domains into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The descent-and-return epistemic circulation is visibly patterned but depends on a reader-supplied directional analogy.
The echo between hostile covers and natural sheaths may be rhetorically active or merely lexical adjacency at whole-surah scale.
شَهِيد may emphasize a knowledge-bearing witness, a present adherent, or both; the broader testimony sequence keeps both possibilities live.
